recovery.archive_paths: All original payload members use paths relative to the historical root; packaging metadata is under carrier/. No absolute path is a tar extraction target.
recovery.historical_report_text: Preserved byte-for-byte, including absolute sandbox references and original pending/authority limitations. Do not rewrite historical paths or results during recovery.
recovery.portable_restore: Extract selected members under a chosen restore root. Resolve any historical /tmp/fabushi-647e-pairing/<relative> reference as <restore-root>/<relative>, or restore to the historical root only when safe and authorized.
recovery.parts: Read index.json parts in sequence order; concatenate raw bytes without base64/text/newline transformations. Every part must match bytes/SHA-256/Git blob SHA. The concatenated bytes must match archive.bytes and archive.sha256.
recovery.tar: Decode gzip/tar as data; inspect and reject absolute/parent-traversal/link targets before materialization. Compare each listed file to member bytes/SHA-256/Git blob. All tar entries here are regular files with normalized mode 0644; original filesystem mode is retained as metadata.
recovery.excluded_dependency_archives: 25 previously acquired exact npm/source archives are intentionally not embedded. Reacquire by each preserved public exact URL and verify integrity/hash; this packaging omission is not source acquisition failure.
recovery.excluded_extracted: 22 derived CI extracted files are recoverable byte-for-byte from the three embedded original ZIPs via omitted_members.reconstruct.
recovery.input_policy: All closure inputs/ copies were retained, including exact upstream lock/package and authority copies. All 51 exact-H audited inputs were retained.
recovery.other_root_source_references: The requested HTML source-index/excerpts and media-next identity/source-hashes/published member records are embedded. Their unselected raw source-copy directories are outside this carrier selection; exact source references and hashes retain their original meaning. The full url-2.5.8 crate and selected LICENSE-APACHE/LICENSE-MIT bytes are embedded.
recovery.no_code_execution: Recovery is file/data transport only. Source, generators, tests, validators, products and harnesses must not be executed as part of this carrier preparation.

authority_limits.root_responsibility: Serialized GitHub API upload/CAS and independent readback; carrier commit/tree remain null until root records actual publication.
